config.notes: Two page kinds. (1) CourseLoop handbook coursehandbook.mq.edu.au/2026/courses|doubledegree/<code>: course data in the page script __NEXT_DATA__ under props.pageProps.pageContent (cricos_code, title, ielts_overall_score, course_duration_in_years, offering list with location and admission_calendar = Session names, fees list with one entry per fee type). Each fee entry's fee_type is an object {label, value} (e.g. value international_fee_paying), so the path filter fees[fee_type=international_fee_paying] matches nothing: the international estimated_annual_fee is in the data but cannot be selected until the worker supports a nested filter (fees[fee_type.value=international_fee_paying]). Handbook page text carries no session, fee or delivery text; the offering admission_calendar gives Session 1/Session 2 but term_months only applies to text patterns. (2) Course pages www.mq.edu.au/study/find-a-course/courses/<slug>: Gatsby pages stored in the domestic view ("I'm a domestic student looking to start my course in 2027"); the international view is a client-side selector and no query parameter switches it (tested ?studentType, student, audience, type, residency, cohort, region=int, international=true on 2 pages, 5 Oct). Start dates: "Location and start dates North Ryde : Session 1 ( 22 February 2027 ) Session 2 ( 26 July 2027 ) Off-campus : ..." (term_months Session 1 = February, Session 2 = July as printed there). Delivery: "Study options Part Time Full Time In person, on campus | Off-campus". 136 bound handbook addresses return 404 and 90 courses are bound only to archived handbooks (2010-2025); none has a current www course page among the 224 known addresses.
